Canadian Opinion on Defence Investment and US Tariffs

Two opinion pieces from Canadian centrist outlets discuss defense investment and trade relations with the United States. One piece argues for increased investment in Canada's defense amid an eroding international order. The other opinion piece details the author's personal effort to advocate against US tariffs on Canadian goods after observing a lack of official representation, expressing dismay at the situation.
